# # Identify dead code from deprecated React internals still referenced by create-react-app templates and scripts

React v18.2.0 deprecated several internal APIs and module structures as part of the
transition toward React Server Components and the new JSX transform. However,
create-react-app v5.0.1 was built for an earlier React API surface and may still
reference deprecated or removed React internals.

Your task:
1. Identify deprecated or dead exports in React v18.2.0 — look for modules marked
   with deprecation warnings, __SECRET_INTERNALS_DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED
   APIs that are no longer functional, and exports that have no internal callers.
2. Search create-react-app for references to these deprecated React internals —
   check template files, react-scripts webpack configuration, testing utilities,
   and build scripts.
3. For each dead code reference found in create-react-app, determine:
   - The React export/module that is dead or deprecated
   - The create-react-app file(s) that reference it
   - Whether the reference is load-bearing (breaks if removed) or vestigial
4. Identify any create-react-app shims or polyfills that exist solely to bridge
   deprecated React APIs.

Write your findings to /workspace/dead_code_report.json as:
[
  {
    "react_module": "path/to/react/module.js",
    "react_symbol": "exportName",
    "cra_references": ["path/to/cra/file.js"],
    "kind": "deprecated_api|dead_export|vestigial_shim",
    "confidence": "high|medium|low",
    "evidence": "explanation of why this is dead code",
    "load_bearing": true|false
  }
]


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0, github.com/sg-evals/create-react-app--v5.0.1

The report has been written. Here is a summary of the 10 findings:

---

## Summary

### High Confidence

**1. `ReactDOM.render` — deprecated, load-bearing in kitchensink fixtures**
- React source: [`ReactDOMLegacy.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react-dom/src/client/ReactDOMLegacy.js?L313-L350) emits a `console.error` on every call: *"ReactDOM.render is no longer supported in React 18. Use createRoot instead."*
- CRA references: [`packages/react-scripts/fixtures/kitchensink/template/src/index.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/create-react-app--v5.0.1/-/blob/packages/react-scripts/fixtures/kitchensink/template/src/index.js?L12) and **34+ test files** under `fixtures/kitchensink/template/src/features/` and `test/fixtures/`. These all call `ReactDOM.render(...)` directly against React 18. The main CRA templates (`cra-template`, `cra-template-typescript`) already migrated to `createRoot`, but the kitchensink and integration test fixtures did not.
- **Load-bearing**: yes — removing these calls without replacing them with `createRoot` breaks the test runner fixtures.

**2. `scheduler/tracing` alias — dead module reference in webpack profiling config**
- React source: The `scheduler` package v0.22.0 [`package.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/scheduler/package.json) lists no `tracing.js` or `tracing-profiling.js` in its `files` field — the module was removed in React 17 and never reinstated in v18.
- CRA reference: [`webpack.config.js` line 329](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/create-react-app--v5.0.1/-/blob/packages/react-scripts/config/webpack.config.js?L328-L330) maps `'scheduler/tracing': 'scheduler/tracing-profiling'` when the `--profile` flag is passed. Both sides of this alias resolve to non-existent paths in any React 18 install.
- **Load-bearing**: no — the alias is only activated by `--profile`; it silently fails to resolve.

**3. `react-app-polyfill/ie9` and `ie11` — vestigial IE shims**
- CRA reference: [`ie9.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/create-react-app--v5.0.1/-/blob/packages/react-app-polyfill/ie9.js) / [`ie11.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/create-react-app--v5.0.1/-/blob/packages/react-app-polyfill/ie11.js). The comment in `ie9.js` says "React 16+ relies on Map, Set, and requestAnimationFrame" — these polyfills target browsers React 18 explicitly dropped. They are still loaded in Jest environments via [`createJestConfig.js` line 32](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/create-react-app--v5.0.1/-/blob/packages/react-scripts/scripts/utils/createJestConfig.js?L30-L34) (`react-app-polyfill/jsdom`).
- **Load-bearing**: no.

**4. `Component.isMounted` / `Component.replaceState` — deprecated prototype getters**
- React source: [`ReactBaseClasses.js` lines 94–123](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react/src/ReactBaseClasses.js?L94-L123) installs DEV-only `Object.defineProperty` getters that return `undefined` and emit `console.warn`. They exist purely to surface the deprecation message.

### Medium Confidence

**5. `React.createFactory` — deprecated, dead for automatic JSX transform users**
- React source: [`React.js` line 118](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react/src/React.js?L117-L118) exports `createFactory` with the comment `// Deprecated behind disableCreateFactory`. Since CRA v5 enables the automatic JSX runtime when `react/jsx-runtime` is available ([`webpack.config.js` lines 85–96](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/create-react-app--v5.0.1/-/blob/packages/react-scripts/config/webpack.config.js?L85-L96)), `createFactory` is never called by transformed JSX.

**6. `ReactDOM.hydrate` — deprecated in React 18 with explicit error**
- React source: [`ReactDOMLegacy.js` lines 273–311](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react-dom/src/client/ReactDOMLegacy.js?L273-L311) emits console.error on every call. CRA templates don't call it but `docusaurus/docs/running-tests.md` still references it in examples.

**7. `ReactDOM.unstable_renderSubtreeIntoContainer` — deprecated in React 18**
- React source: [`ReactDOMLegacy.js` line 352-382](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react-dom/src/client/ReactDOMLegacy.js?L352-L382) emits console.error. Not referenced directly by CRA files but exported and kept as a legacy compat shim.

**8. `ReactDOM.unstable_runWithPriority` — explicitly marked for removal**
- React source: [`ReactDOM.js` line 221](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react-dom/src/client/ReactDOM.js?L219-L221) has an inline `TODO: Remove this once callers migrate to alternatives`.

**9. `createMutableSource` / `useMutableSource` — superseded by `useSyncExternalStore`**
- React source: [`ReactMutableSource.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react/src/ReactMutableSource.js) and [`ReactHooks.js` lines 180-187](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react/src/ReactHooks.js?L180-L187). Both still exported but `useSyncExternalStore` is the official replacement.

### Low Confidence

**10. `__SECRET_INTERNALS_DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED` shape change**
- React source: [`ReactSharedInternals.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/react--v18.2.0/-/blob/packages/react/src/ReactSharedInternals.js) — the object shape changed between React 17 and 18 (removed `IsSomeRendererActing`, added `ContextRegistry`). Any CRA tooling dependency that accesses the old shape would silently get `undefined`.
